It shows every stored task in a table and summarises the tasks with three metrics: Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks.","business_value":"Users get one place to see all tasks and their overall progress without opening each task.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The user has at least one task stored in the system","when":"The user opens the Task Reporting page without applying any filter","then":"The table shows one row for every stored task"},{"given":"Stored tasks with the statuses Open, In Progress and Completed exist","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"Total Tasks equals the number of all stored tasks, Open Tasks equals the number of tasks with status Open, and Completed Tasks equals the number of tasks with status Completed"},{"given":"No tasks are stored in the system","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"The table has no task rows and Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks each show 0"},{"given":"The metrics endpoint is called without any filter or search parameters","when":"The endpoint responds successfully","then":"The response contains the Total, Open and Completed counts of all stored tasks"},{"given":"The metrics endpoint is called and a task has the status In Progress","when":"The endpoint responds successfully","then":"The In Progress task is included in Total Tasks and is not included in Open Tasks or Completed Tasks"}],"edge_cases":["A task with the status In Progress counts toward Total Tasks only;
